basic_info.description: Live Above It All in Silver Terrace!  Perched atop an oversized lot, this classic mid-century single-family home captures sweeping views of Downtown San Francisco, the Bay Bridge, and beyond. A rare opportunity in one of the city's sunniest neighborhoods, this home is ready to shine with your personal touch. The main level features a spacious living room with a brick cased fireplace and large front-facing windows that showcase the stunning skyline. The bright kitchen offers ample counter space and cabinetry and opens to a formal dining area perfect for entertaining. Two sunny bedrooms and a full bathroom complete the upper floor. Downstairs, a large garage includes extra space for laundry and a potential workshop.  There is also an attached in-law studio on the ground floor. The expansive backyard and patio space are perfect for gardening, BBQs, and enjoying the sun-soaked surroundings. Don't miss this chance to create your dream home atop Silver Terrace!
